ios.desc:
World news, reimagined.

In a world overflowing with news, Azimut gives you a new heading. Instantly see where major events are happening, dive into the details that matter, and take control of how you consume information.

One Map, Thousands of Stories
Every marker on the map represents a real event. Zoom in, explore, and discover what's happening across the world – or right next door.

A Feed That Gets to the Point
Inspired by the best mobile experiences, swipe vertically to browse the news. Each card presents the essentials: title, summary, image, and location.

FastRecap: News in Fast-Forward
Short on time? FastRecap mode guides you through recent events in just seconds. Perfect for your coffee break.

Your Filters, Your Focus
Choose what matters to you: filter by continent, category, or time period. Follow only what you haven't read yet.

Share Your Perspective
Comment on events and discover viewpoints from other users.
